name: Lost&Found
source:
Life has always been smooth for Olivia Sasaki, but she’s kept people at a distance. At 16, she’s leaving America for Japan to live with her older brother, Jacob, hoping to start anew while facing the unexpected challenges of a familiar yet different world.

[From [url=https://msmodstudios.itch.io/lostfound-the-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
佐佐木奥利维亚（Olivia Sasaki）的生活一直很顺利，但她却与人保持距离。16岁时，她离开美国前往日本与哥哥雅各布一起生活，希望能够重新开始，同时面对熟悉但不同的世界带来的意想不到的挑战。

[来自[url=https://msmodstudios.itch.io/lostfound-the-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
